finding_crlf_xml_normalization:
The 4 TJMS candidates' raw texto_limpo uses CRLF (
) line endings exclusively. XML 1.0's mandatory end-of-line handling (sec 2.11) normalizes all 
 and  to 
 during parsing, so scripts/ingest_juris_technique1_batch.py's reconstruction (ET.fromstring on the subagent's tagged text) can never byte-for-byte match a CRLF source string, regardless of annotation quality -- confirmed by first patching the tagged files (LF->CRLF) with no effect, since the parser strips the  right back out. Fix applied: normalize texto_limpo to LF before building the candidate/document record (not by asking subagents to preserve CRLF, which XML parsing structurally cannot round-trip). This is a store-wide implication for any future CRLF-sourced candidate, not specific to TJMS.
